best_for: Math teachers and students who build their own constructions and worksheets and want the classic GeoGebra layout working offline on a desktop.

points.title: Free for school, not for business
points.text: GeoGebra is free for non-commercial use, including teaching in fee-charging schools. Selling materials, paid training, non-academic books and ad-funded use all need a commercial license.

points.title: Credit is required
points.text: Non-commercial users must show a notice such as Made with GeoGebra with a link to the site when they share work.

points.title: Classic or Calculator Suite
points.text: Classic keeps the traditional interface with extra options for authors. GeoGebra recommends the newer Calculator Suite to new users but says it will keep supporting Classic.

points.title: Works offline after install
points.text: The main math tools run without internet. Sign-in, online resources and saving or sharing online still need a connection.

points.title: 32-bit Windows builds
points.text: The Windows installers here are x86, offered as a per-user .exe and as MSI packages for per-user or machine-wide installs. The Windows listing keeps 7 versions.

points.title: Mac and Linux catches
points.text: The Mac zip is universal and needs macOS 12. Its Homebrew cask was disabled on 2026-09-01 after failing Apple's Gatekeeper check. The Flatpak is not marked verified on Flathub and was at 6.0.804 when Windows was at 6.0.936.
